[{"node": "menu_content109", "element": "menu_content", "data": {"label": "Taking Orders", "key": "taking_orders_menu_content", "id": "taking_orders_menu_content", "name": "taking_orders_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"node": "markdown101", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Opening a table", "key": "md_opening_a_table", "id": "opening-a-table", "name": "md_opening_a_table", "value": "# Opening a table

Tap a table to open its orders. The first item you add creates the order. A table can have several orders (for example, one per guest); switch between them with the tabs at the top, which show how many items each one has.

The header shows the **menu in force** for that room.
"}}, {"node": "markdown102", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "The catalog", "key": "md_the_catalog", "id": "the-catalog", "name": "md_the_catalog", "value": "# The catalog

The catalog shows the items of the menu in force, in the menu's order and grouped by item group. You can:

- **search** by name or code;
- filter by **dietary tags** (Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-free…); each item shows its tags and allergens as small chips;
- see items that ran out (**86**) greyed out. People allowed to do it can mark items sold out or back with the **86** button; every screen of the restaurant updates at once.
"}}, {"node": "markdown103", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Adding items, options and combos", "key": "md_adding_items_options_and_combos", "id": "adding-items-options-and-combos", "name": "md_adding_items_options_and_combos", "value": "# Adding items, options and combos

Tap an item to add it. Items with **options** open a picker already set the way the item comes:

- uncheck an included part to remove it (**NO Tomato**);
- add extras, some more than once (**Cheese x2**);
- swap a side in a pick-one group (**Salad (instead of Fries)**);
- **required** sections must be answered; when a section is full, the rest are disabled;
- items with **sizes** show them first (Small, Large…) and the line is the size chosen;
- a component brings its own choices under it: the burger of a combo offers its cooking point and parts, the drink asks for its size.

The price updates as you choose. Tap the same dish with the same options again to increase its quantity; different options create a separate line. See **Combos**.
"}}, {"node": "markdown104", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Customer, guests and notes", "key": "md_customer_guests_and_notes", "id": "customer-guests-and-notes", "name": "md_customer_guests_and_notes", "value": "# Customer, guests and notes

From the order header set the **customer**, the number of **guests** and an **order note** (it prints on the kitchen tickets). Each line can have its own note too.
"}}, {"node": "markdown105", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Editing a line", "key": "md_editing_a_line", "id": "editing-a-line", "name": "md_editing_a_line", "value": "# Editing a line

Select a line to change its quantity, options or notes. Lines can be edited while their status allows it (statuses marked **Waiter Can Edit**, such as Pending). Once sent, a line belongs to the kitchen.

Discounts above your role's maximum and price changes your role doesn't allow ask for a **manager PIN** right there (see **Permissions**).
"}}, {"node": "markdown106", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Sending to the kitchen", "key": "md_sending_to_the_kitchen", "id": "sending-to-the-kitchen", "name": "md_sending_to_the_kitchen", "value": "# Sending to the kitchen

Press **Send**. Pending lines go to every production center that prepares them, on their screen and, if configured, on their printer. Lines added later are sent as a **new round**: a new ticket at the kitchen.
"}}, {"node": "markdown107", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Divide, transfer and void", "key": "md_divide_transfer_and_void", "id": "divide-transfer-and-void", "name": "md_divide_transfer_and_void", "value": "# Divide, transfer and void

- **Divide** moves some items to a new order on the same table (to pay them separately).
- **Transfer** moves the whole order to another table of the same restaurant.
- **Void** removes items. Lines not sent yet are removed freely; lines already sent need the *Void sent items* permission (or a manager PIN) and a reason. Every void is logged and shown at the production center.
"}}, {"node": "markdown108", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "On a phone", "key": "md_on_a_phone", "id": "on-a-phone", "name": "md_on_a_phone", "value": "# On a phone

On phones the catalog fills the screen and a cart bar at the bottom shows the count and total. Tap it to see the order, edit lines, **Send** or **Pay**. Everything else is in the **⋯** menu.
"}}]}]
